data.notes: January’s confirmed music calendar in Verbier is après-ski-led, with Farinet, Soâr, Pub Mont Fort and pop-up DJ nights carrying the scene rather than a major festival.

events.title: New Year’s Eve Ticket 2025 at Pub Mont Fort
events.summary: Pub Mont Fort’s ticketed New Year party runs into the early hours of 1 January 2026, with guests invited to dance into 2026 at one of Verbier’s established après-ski venues.

events.title: Buffet Sonore – Disco Evening
events.summary: Buffet Sonore brings a mobile vintage-style disco to the Parc de Loisirs ice rink, with DJs playing funky, Afro and Latino sounds; the confirmed special evening on 3 January is a Disco Evening.

events.title: Farinet Après-ski Live Band Residency
events.summary: Farinet Après-ski confirms live band music every evening from 18:00 to 21:00 during its 1 January–12 April 2026 winter run; 1 January is used as the representative January date.

events.title: Soâr Boutique Club Electronic Nights
events.summary: Soâr Boutique Club’s winter programme is confirmed from 1 January to 30 April 2026, focused on melodic techno, tech house and Afro-house DJ sets from local and international guests; 1 January is used as the representative January date.

events.title: Jazz & Soul Thursdays at SOUTH Restaurant & Club
events.summary: SOUTH Restaurant & Club confirms Jazz & Soul Thursdays with live artists from 21:00 during its 1 January–18 April 2026 season, before the room turns into a late-night dance floor.

events.title: The Sons of Guns at Farinet Hotel
events.summary: The Sons of Guns’ official concert page lists a January run at Farinet Hotel in Verbier from the 13th through the 19th, bringing the band’s 70s-inspired rock, blues and folk sound to the après-ski circuit.

events.title: Front Left presents Scarlett O’Malley
events.summary: Front Left brings London DJ and Club Cowgirl founder Scarlett O’Malley to Loft Bar on 24 January, with the event listing describing a deep, soulful house set moving through minimal, tech and Latin-leaning rhythms.

events.title: MAYE x FLUO
events.summary: Verbier Tourism lists MAYE x FLUO in nearby Riddes on 31 January, a free retro-themed evening with DJ music, 80s sounds and fluorescent lighting.
